name: Otose! Hitozuma Megami-sama
source:
Alone with a sexy married woman in a fantasy world?

One day, the lead character is taken to a different world with a next-door married-woman Sakatsuki Yuko whom he is in love with and wants to posses. In the fantasy world, Yuko is somehow received into a village as Battle Goddess to protect the village from goblins, and you happens to work for Yuko in the fantasy world!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE027961.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
和性感的已婚女性一起被困在奇幻世界？

一天，主人公与住在隔壁、令他爱慕并渴望占有的已婚女子五月优子一同被带往异世界。在这个奇幻世界里，优子不知为何被村庄奉为战斗女神，负责保护村民免受哥布林侵袭，而你则恰好成了她的部下！
